question: In 2025, which government’s commitment was emphasised by the inauguration of the Khelo India multipurpose hall in Arunachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Government**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The inauguration of the **Khelo India multipurpose hall** in **Arunachal Pradesh** in **2025** stands as a clear reflection of the **Union Government's** unwavering commitment to the development of the **North Eastern Region (NER)**.
 
• This infrastructure project was executed under the **Khelo India Scheme**, which is a flagship national program spearheaded by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, **Government of India**.
 
• The **Union Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports**, during the visit to **Arunachal Pradesh**, emphasized that the **Union Government** aims to bridge the geographical and infrastructural gap between the **North East** and the rest of the country through high-quality sports facilities.
